citation.authors: Skurvydas A, Istomina N, Dadeliene R, et al.
citation.title: Physiological and psychological responses to five-day fasting

population.description: 42 women; inclusion: aged 40-60 y, 'generally healthy', stable weight for 3 months, no weight-loss intervention in 3 months, no medication directly affecting metabolism (e.g. corticosteroids, thyroid hormones); exclusion: severe chronic disease 'including uncontrolled diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, or cancer', drugs influencing metabolic or inflammatory markers, hormone replacement therapy. The authors call them 'healthy women' (Participants) but screen only by these criteria and no measurement, so controlled diabetes or hypertension is not excluded, and mean BMI is 30.8 (Table 1, printed 'KMI'): entered as unselected. Age min/max not printed (the enrolment range 40-60 sits oddly with SD 9.3). Menopausal status not assessed.

protocols.name: before_fast
protocols.description: Sample at the beginning of the 5-day fast, after the four-week preparation (three meals a day, no snacking; no meal plan, compliance not monitored). Serum insulin and leptin drawn 7:00-9:00 AM 'in a fasted state' on the first day of the programme (Methods, 'Testing of organokines'); the paper gives neither the clock hour nor the hours fasted, so 08:00 and 10 h are the guide's defaults, and a 30-minute run-in stands for the single sample. Blood pressure and bioimpedance fat mass (Tanita BC-300): time and conditions not stated, entered on the same fasted morning. n = 42 women, age 49.8 +/- 9.3 y, BMI 30.8 +/- 5.6 (Table 1).

left_out.what: All 'After' (day 5) values of glucose, insulin, ketone body, leptin, SBP, DBP and fat mass (Table 2): the five fasting days included a daily 50-min morning exercise session, a daily 5-7 km walk at 50-70% of maximum heart rate (maximum not printed), a 60-minute massage on day 2 and a 70 degC humid sauna of three 15-20 min rounds on day 3 (Procedures); hours fasted at the day-5 draw also not printed

Glucose and ketone body (beta-hydroxybutyrate) 'Before' (Table 2): capillary meter readings (Methods: glucose three times a day, ketone on fasting days 1, 3, 5); the table does not say which reading, at what time or in what fed state; ketone mean 0.82 mmol/l
Body mass, lean body mass, water mass, waist circumference, waist-to-hip ratio, visceral fat area, fat mass % before/after (Table 2)
Basal energy expenditure (kcal/day), from the bioimpedance analyser, before/after (Table 2); how it was derived is not stated
After/before % and Cohen d columns of Table 2: a percentage of each person's own value and a standardized effect, not a difference in the marker's unit
Glucose 3x/day and ketones on fasting days 1, 3, 5 (Figure 1A only)
